title: RMS CET Class 6 · 2021 Pattern Paper
description: RMS CET Class 6 paper on the 2021 pattern: 200 questions (English 50, Intelligence 50, Mathematics 50, General Knowledge 50), 150 minutes, 200 marks, 1 mark each, no negative marking. Original practice paper on the 2021 pattern (not the official paper). Free.

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to BRAVE.
questions.explanation: "Brave" means not afraid of danger, which is the same as "courageous".
questions.explanationHi: "Brave" का अर्थ है साहसी, यानी "courageous"।

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to HUGE.
questions.explanation: "Huge" means very big; "enormous" also means very big.
questions.explanationHi: "Huge" = बहुत बड़ा = "enormous"।

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to BEGIN.
questions.explanation: "Begin" and "commence" both mean to start.
questions.explanationHi: "Begin" और "commence" दोनों का अर्थ है शुरू करना।

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to RAPID.
questions.explanation: "Rapid" means fast or quick.
questions.explanationHi: "Rapid" = तेज़।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to ANCIENT.
questions.explanation: "Ancient" means very old; its opposite is "modern" (new).
questions.explanationHi: "Ancient" (प्राचीन) का विलोम "modern" (आधुनिक) है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to VICTORY.
questions.explanation: The opposite of winning (victory) is losing (defeat).
questions.explanationHi: "Victory" (जीत) का विलोम "defeat" (हार) है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to GENEROUS.
questions.explanation: A generous person gives freely; a selfish person thinks only of himself.
questions.explanationHi: "Generous" (उदार) का विलोम "selfish" (स्वार्थी) है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to ARRIVE.
questions.explanation: To arrive is to come; to depart is to go away.
questions.explanationHi: "Arrive" (पहुँचना) का विलोम "depart" (रवाना होना) है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to HUMBLE.
questions.explanation: A humble person does not boast; the opposite is "proud".
questions.explanationHi: "Humble" (विनम्र) का विलोम "proud" (घमंडी) है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: "Honest" begins with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so we use "an".
questions.explanationHi: "honest" में h नहीं बोला जाता, स्वर ध्वनि से शुरू होता है, इसलिए "an"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: ___ Ganga is a holy river.
questions.explanation: We use "the" before the names of rivers.
questions.explanationHi: नदियों के नाम से पहले "the" लगता है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: I saw ___ one-eyed crow on the wall.
questions.explanation: "One" begins with a "w" sound (won), which is a consonant sound, so we use "a".
questions.explanationHi: "one" का उच्चारण "वन" है जो व्यंजन ध्वनि है, इसलिए "a"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The cat is hiding ___ the bed, so we cannot see it.
questions.explanation: Something hidden below the bed is "under" it.
questions.explanationHi: पलंग के नीचे = under।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: She has been ill ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: We use "since" with a point of time (Monday) in the present perfect tense.
questions.explanationHi: समय के एक बिंदु (Monday) के साथ "since" लगता है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The soldiers marched ___ the bridge to the other side of the river.
questions.explanation: Going from one side to the other side is "across".
questions.explanationHi: एक ओर से दूसरी ओर जाना = across।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Rohan is very fond ___ music.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is "fond of".
questions.explanationHi: सही प्रयोग "fond of" है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Look! The children ___ in the park.
questions.explanation: "Look!" shows the action is happening now, so we use the present continuous "are playing".
questions.explanationHi: "Look!" से पता चलता है कि काम अभी हो रहा है, इसलिए "are playing"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: My father ___ to Delhi yesterday.
questions.explanation: "Yesterday" shows past time, so we use the simple past "went".
questions.explanationHi: "yesterday" भूतकाल दर्शाता है, इसलिए "went"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.explanation: A universal truth is written in the simple present tense: "rises".
questions.explanationHi: सार्वभौमिक सत्य के लिए simple present: "rises"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: By next year, I ___ in Class 6.
questions.explanation: "Next year" is future time, so we use "will be".
questions.explanationHi: "next year" भविष्य काल है, इसलिए "will be"।

questions.text: Choose the correct collective noun: a ___ of lions.
questions.explanation: A group of lions is called a pride.
questions.explanationHi: शेरों के समूह को "pride" कहते हैं।

questions.text: What is the plural of CHILD?
questions.explanation: CHILD has an irregular plural: children.
questions.explanationHi: CHILD का बहुवचन "children" है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct pronoun: Riya and ___ went to the market.
questions.explanation: The pronoun is part of the subject, so we use "I".
questions.explanationHi: कर्ता (subject) के रूप में "I" आता है।

questions.text: Which word is an adjective in the sentence: "The tall boy ran fast."?
questions.explanation: "Tall" describes the noun "boy", so it is an adjective.
questions.explanationHi: "tall" संज्ञा "boy" की विशेषता बताता है, इसलिए विशेषण है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: This is the ___ building in our town.
questions.explanation: When one thing is compared with all others, we use the superlative "tallest".
questions.explanationHi: सबसे ऊँचा = superlative "tallest"।

questions.text: One word for "a person who flies an aeroplane":
questions.explanation: A pilot flies an aeroplane.
questions.explanationHi: हवाई जहाज़ उड़ाने वाला = pilot।

questions.text: One word for "a building where soldiers live":
questions.explanation: Soldiers live in barracks.
questions.explanationHi: सैनिकों के रहने का स्थान = barracks।

questions.text: One word for "a person who can neither read nor write":
questions.explanation: A person who cannot read or write is illiterate.
questions.explanationHi: जो पढ़-लिख न सके = illiterate (निरक्षर)।

questions.text: One word for "a doctor who treats teeth":
questions.explanation: A dentist treats teeth.
questions.explanationHi: दाँतों का डॉक्टर = dentist।

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y (one c, double s).
questions.explanationHi: सही वर्तनी: necessary (एक c, दो s)।

questions.text: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L.
questions.explanationHi: सही वर्तनी: beautiful।

questions.text: Pick the word with the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is G-O-V-E-R-N-M-E-N-T.
questions.explanationHi: सही वर्तनी: government।

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: With "he" (singular) we use "does not" + the base verb "like".
questions.explanationHi: "he" के साथ "does not like" आता है।

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: She is more cleverer than her sister.
She is cleverer than her sister.
She is most clever than her sister.
She is clever than her sister.
questions.explanation: "Cleverer" is already the comparative form, so "more" is not needed.
questions.explanationHi: "cleverer" स्वयं तुलनात्मक रूप है, "more" नहीं लगाते।

questions.text: Pick the sentence that has no error.
options: Each of the boys has a bag.
Each of the boys have a bag.
Each of the boy have a bag.
Each of the boys having a bag.
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, so it takes the singular verb "has".
questions.explanationHi: "each" एकवचन है, इसलिए "has"।

questions.text: Choose the correct question for the answer: "Ravi lives in Jaipur."
questions.explanation: A question in the simple present uses "does" + subject + base verb: "Where does Ravi live?"
questions.explanationHi: प्रश्न: Where + does + Ravi + live?

questions.text: Choose the correct question for the answer: "The train leaves at 6 o'clock."
questions.explanation: We use "does" with a singular subject and the base verb "leave".
questions.explanationHi: "does" के बाद क्रिया का मूल रूप "leave" आता है।

questions.text: The idiom "a piece of cake" means
questions.explanation: "A piece of cake" means a task that is very easy.
questions.explanationHi: "a piece of cake" = बहुत आसान काम।

questions.text: The idiom "to burn the midnight oil" means
options: to work or study late at night
to light a lamp in a temple
questions.explanation: It means to stay awake late at night working or studying.
questions.explanationHi: देर रात तक पढ़ना या काम करना।

questions.text: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence: flag / the / proudly / soldier / saluted / the
options: Proudly the the soldier saluted flag.
The flag proudly saluted the soldier.
The soldier proudly saluted the flag.
The soldier saluted proudly flag the.
questions.explanation: Subject (The soldier) + adverb (proudly) + verb (saluted) + object (the flag).
questions.explanationHi: कर्ता + क्रिया-विशेषण + क्रिया + कर्म।

Dear Mother,
I hope you and Father are well. Here at our post in the mountains, the mornings are very cold, and the stream below is covered with thin ice. Every day we wake up at five, do our exercises and then go on patrol along the border. My friend Hari from Kerala shares my tent. He has taught me to make a tasty coconut chutney, though we have no fresh coconuts here! Last week a heavy snowfall blocked the road, and we helped the villagers clear it. An old woman gave us hot tea and called us her sons. That made me feel proud of my uniform. Please tell little Meena to study hard and not to worry about me. I will come home on leave before Diwali and bring her a woollen cap.
Your loving son,
Arjun

questions.passage: The peacock is the national bird of India. It was given this honour in 1963. The male bird is famous for its long, shining train of green and blue feathers. Each feather has a mark that looks like an eye. When dark clouds gather before the rain, the peacock spreads its train like a fan and dances. The female, called a peahen, is smaller and brown, and she does not have a long train. Peacocks eat seeds, insects and even small snakes, so farmers think of them as friends. At night they sleep on high branches of trees to stay safe from wild cats. Their loud call can be heard from far away. In India, it is against the law to hunt the peacock, and people in many villages feed them with grain.

questions.text: Complete the analogy: 3 : 27 :: 4 : ?
questions.explanation: 27 = 3 × 3 × 3 (cube of 3). So the answer is the cube of 4 = 4 × 4 × 4 = 64.

questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर एक आगे बढ़ता है: P→Q, R→S, अतः QS।

questions.text: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: The differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.text: Find the next number: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is doubled: 40 × 2 = 80.

questions.text: Find the next number: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: These are squares: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², so next is 6² = 36.

questions.text: Find the next number: 100, 95, 85, 70, ?

questions.text: Find the next letter: Z, X, V, T, ?

questions.textHi: रमेश, सुरेश का पुत्र है। कमला, सुरेश की माँ है। कमला का रमेश से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: Kamla is the mother of Ramesh's father, so she is his grandmother.
questions.explanationHi: कमला रमेश के पिता की माँ है, अतः दादी।

questions.text: Pointing to a girl, Amit said, "She is the daughter of my father's only son." How is the girl related to Amit?
questions.textHi: एक लड़की की ओर इशारा करते हुए अमित ने कहा, "यह मेरे पिता के इकलौते पुत्र की बेटी है।" लड़की का अमित से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: Amit's father's only son is Amit himself, so the girl is Amit's daughter.
questions.explanationHi: अमित के पिता का इकलौता पुत्र स्वयं अमित है, अतः लड़की उसकी बेटी है।

questions.text: A's brother is B. B's father is C. How is C related to A?
questions.textHi: A का भाई B है। B के पिता C हैं। C का A से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A and B are children of the same parents, so B's father C is also A's father.
questions.explanationHi: A और B भाई-बहन हैं, इसलिए B के पिता C ही A के भी पिता हैं।

questions.text: Rohit is the brother of Meena's mother. How is Rohit related to Meena?
questions.textHi: रोहित, मीना की माँ का भाई है। रोहित का मीना से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A mother's brother is the maternal uncle (mama).
questions.explanationHi: माँ का भाई मामा होता है।

questions.text: Ravi walks 5 km towards the north, then turns right and walks 3 km. In which direction is he facing now?
questions.textHi: रवि 5 km उत्तर की ओर चलता है, फिर दाएँ मुड़कर 3 km चलता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: Facing north, a right turn makes you face east.
questions.explanationHi: उत्तर की ओर मुख करके दाएँ मुड़ने पर मुख पूर्व की ओर होता है।

questions.text: Sita walks 4 km towards the east and then 3 km towards the north. How far is she from her starting point?
questions.textHi: सीता 4 km पूर्व की ओर और फिर 3 km उत्तर की ओर चलती है। वह अपने आरंभिक स्थान से कितनी दूर है?
questions.explanation: The paths make a right angle. Distance = √(4² + 3²) = √25 = 5 km.

questions.text: You are facing north. If you turn through 180°, which direction will you face?
questions.textHi: आपका मुख उत्तर की ओर है। यदि आप 180° घूम जाएँ, तो आपका मुख किस दिशा में होगा?
questions.explanation: Turning 180° (half a turn) makes you face the opposite direction: south.
questions.explanationHi: 180° घूमने से विपरीत दिशा, यानी दक्षिण।

questions.text: A man is facing west. He turns 90° clockwise. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.textHi: एक व्यक्ति का मुख पश्चिम की ओर है। वह 90° दक्षिणावर्त (घड़ी की दिशा में) घूमता है। अब उसका मुख किस ओर है?
questions.explanation: Clockwise order is North → East → South → West → North. After west comes north.
questions.explanationHi: घड़ी की दिशा में क्रम: उत्तर → पूर्व → दक्षिण → पश्चिम → उत्तर।

questions.text: In a row of 25 children, Mohan is 9th from the left end. What is his position from the right end?
questions.textHi: 25 बच्चों की एक पंक्ति में मोहन बाएँ छोर से 9वाँ है। दाएँ छोर से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 25 − 9 + 1 = 17.

questions.text: Rita is taller than Gita but shorter than Nita. Who is the tallest?
questions.textHi: रीता, गीता से लंबी है पर नीता से छोटी है। सबसे लंबी कौन है?
questions.explanation: Order: Nita > Rita > Gita. So Nita is the tallest.
questions.explanationHi: क्रम: नीता > रीता > गीता; अतः नीता सबसे लंबी।

questions.text: In a class, Raju is 12th from the top and 18th from the bottom. How many students are there in the class?
questions.textHi: एक कक्षा में राजू ऊपर से 12वाँ और नीचे से 18वाँ है। कक्षा में कितने विद्यार्थी हैं?
questions.explanation: Total = 12 + 18 − 1 = 29 (Raju is counted twice).

questions.text: If today is Monday, which day will it be after 10 days?
questions.textHi: यदि आज सोमवार है, तो 10 दिन बाद कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: After 7 days it is Monday again; 3 more days give Thursday.
questions.explanationHi: 7 दिन बाद फिर सोमवार; 3 दिन और = गुरुवार।

questions.text: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3 o'clock?
questions.textHi: 3 बजे घड़ी की घंटे और मिनट की सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark is 30° apart. At 3:00 the hands are 3 marks apart: 3 × 30° = 90°.

questions.text: 1 January 2021 was a Friday. Which day was 10 January 2021?
questions.textHi: 1 जनवरी 2021 को शुक्रवार था। 10 जनवरी 2021 को कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 8 January was also a Friday (7 days later). 9 Jan = Saturday, 10 Jan = Sunday.
questions.explanationHi: 8 जनवरी भी शुक्रवार; 9 = शनिवार, 10 = रविवार।

questions.text: If '+' means '×' and '×' means '+', then what is 6 + 3 × 4?
questions.explanation: Change the signs: 6 × 3 + 4 = 18 + 4 = 22.

questions.text: Find the missing number. Row 1: 4, 5, 9; Row 2: 7, 6, 13; Row 3: 8, 9, ?
questions.explanation: In each row the third number is the sum of the first two: 8 + 9 = 17.
questions.explanationHi: हर पंक्ति में तीसरी संख्या पहली दो का योग है: 8 + 9 = 17।

questions.text: In a class, 20 students like tea, 15 like coffee and 5 like both. How many students like tea or coffee (or both)?
questions.textHi: एक कक्षा में 20 विद्यार्थी चाय, 15 कॉफ़ी और 5 दोनों पसंद करते हैं। कितने विद्यार्थी चाय या कॉफ़ी (या दोनों) पसंद करते हैं?
questions.explanation: In a Venn diagram the 5 who like both are counted twice: 20 + 15 − 5 = 30.
questions.explanationHi: वेन आरेख में दोनों पसंद करने वाले 5 दो बार गिने गए: 20 + 15 − 5 = 30।

questions.text: Which capital letter looks exactly the same in a mirror placed to its right?
questions.textHi: दाईं ओर रखे दर्पण में कौन-सा बड़ा अक्षर बिल्कुल वैसा ही दिखता है?
questions.explanation: A is the same on its left and right halves, so its mirror image is unchanged. F, R and G get reversed.
questions.explanationHi: A के बाएँ और दाएँ भाग समान हैं, इसलिए दर्पण में वैसा ही दिखता है।

questions.text: A stationery shop sold pens on five days: Monday 25, Tuesday 30, Wednesday 20, Thursday 35, Friday 40. How many more pens were sold on Friday than on Wednesday?
questions.textHi: एक स्टेशनरी की दुकान ने पाँच दिनों में पेन बेचे: सोमवार 25, मंगलवार 30, बुधवार 20, गुरुवार 35, शुक्रवार 40। शुक्रवार को बुधवार से कितने पेन अधिक बिके?
questions.explanation: Friday 40 − Wednesday 20 = 20.

questions.text: What is the smallest number that is exactly divisible by 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6?
questions.textHi: 2, 3, 4, 5 और 6 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: This is the LCM of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 = 60.

questions.text: What is the successor of 99,999?
questions.textHi: 99,999 का परवर्ती क्या है?
questions.explanation: The successor is 1 more: 99,999 + 1 = 1,00,000.

questions.text: How many factors does 12 have?
questions.textHi: 12 के कितने गुणनखंड हैं?
questions.explanation: The factors of 12 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12: six factors.

questions.text: A shopkeeper sells a toy for ₹275 and makes a profit of ₹55. What was the cost price?
questions.textHi: एक दुकानदार खिलौना ₹275 में बेचकर ₹55 लाभ कमाता है। क्रय मूल्य क्या था?
questions.explanation: CP = SP − profit = 275 − 55 = ₹220.

questions.text: Find the value: 0.5 × 0.4 = ?
questions.explanation: 5 × 4 = 20 and there are two decimal places in all: 0.20 = 0.2.

questions.text: What is 1/2 of 1/3 of 600?
₹720 is divided between Amit and Sumit in the ratio 5 : 3. How much does Amit get?
questions.textHi: ₹720 को अमित और सुमित में 5 : 3 के अनुपात में बाँटा गया। अमित को कितने रुपये मिले?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 8. One part = 720 ÷ 8 = ₹90. Amit gets 5 × 90 = ₹450.

questions.text: A school bag is marked at ₹800. The shop gives a discount of 15%. How much does the customer pay?
questions.textHi: एक स्कूल बैग का अंकित मूल्य ₹800 है। दुकान 15% छूट देती है। ग्राहक कितना भुगतान करेगा?
questions.explanation: Discount = 15% of 800 = ₹120. Price paid = 800 − 120 = ₹680.

questions.text: 6,748 rounded off to the nearest hundred is
questions.textHi: 6,748 को निकटतम सैकड़े में पूर्णांकित करने पर मिलता है:
questions.explanation: The tens digit is 4 (less than 5), so we round down to 6,700.
questions.explanationHi: दहाई का अंक 4 (5 से कम) है, अतः 6,700।

questions.text: In 1919, the Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.textHi: 1919 में जलियाँवाला बाग हत्याकांड किस शहर में हुआ था?
questions.explanation: Jallianwala Bagh is in Amritsar, Punjab. On 13 April 1919 British troops fired on a peaceful crowd there.
questions.explanationHi: जलियाँवाला बाग अमृतसर (पंजाब) में है; 13 अप्रैल 1919 को वहाँ निहत्थी भीड़ पर गोली चलाई गई।

questions.text: In 1930, Gandhiji began the Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) from which place?
questions.textHi: 1930 में गांधीजी ने दांडी यात्रा (नमक सत्याग्रह) कहाँ से शुरू की थी?
questions.explanation: Gandhiji walked from Sabarmati Ashram (Ahmedabad) to Dandi on the coast to make salt.
questions.explanationHi: गांधीजी साबरमती आश्रम (अहमदाबाद) से दांडी तक पैदल चले और नमक बनाया।

questions.text: Who gave the call "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement?
questions.textHi: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के दौरान "करो या मरो" का नारा किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi gave the call "Do or Die" when the Quit India Movement began.
questions.explanationHi: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के आरंभ में गांधीजी ने "करो या मरो" का नारा दिया।

questions.text: In which year did the Quit India Movement begin?
questions.textHi: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement began on 8–9 August 1942.
questions.explanationHi: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन अगस्त 1942 में शुरू हुआ।

questions.text: Who said, "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it"?
questions.textHi: "स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है और मैं इसे लेकर रहूँगा" किसने कहा?
questions.explanation: This famous slogan was given by Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
questions.explanationHi: यह प्रसिद्ध नारा लोकमान्य बाल गंगाधर तिलक का है।

questions.text: The Indian National Congress was founded in
questions.textHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना कब हुई?
questions.explanation: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 in Bombay (now Mumbai).
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना 1885 में बंबई (मुंबई) में हुई।

questions.text: Who led the Indian National Army (Azad Hind Fauj)?
questions.textHi: आज़ाद हिंद फ़ौज (INA) का नेतृत्व किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose led the Azad Hind Fauj and gave the slogan "Give me blood, and I will give you freedom".
questions.explanationHi: नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने आज़ाद हिंद फ़ौज का नेतृत्व किया।

questions.text: Rani Lakshmibai, a heroine of the Revolt of 1857, was the queen of
questions.textHi: 1857 के विद्रोह की नायिका रानी लक्ष्मीबाई कहाँ की रानी थीं?
questions.explanation: Rani Lakshmibai was the Rani of Jhansi.
questions.explanationHi: रानी लक्ष्मीबाई झाँसी की रानी थीं।

questions.text: Who is known as the "Iron Man of India"?
questions.textHi: "भारत का लौह पुरुष" किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Sardar Patel united more than 500 princely states with India and is called the Iron Man of India.
questions.explanationHi: सरदार पटेल ने 500 से अधिक रियासतों को भारत में मिलाया; उन्हें लौह पुरुष कहते हैं।

questions.text: Which is the longest river of India?
questions.textHi: भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: The Ganga, about 2,500 km long, is the longest river of India.
questions.explanationHi: लगभग 2,500 km लंबी गंगा भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी है।

questions.text: Which river is called the "Dakshin Ganga" (Ganga of the South)?
questions.textHi: किस नदी को "दक्षिण गंगा" कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Godavari is the longest river of South India and is called the Dakshin Ganga.
questions.explanationHi: गोदावरी दक्षिण भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी है, इसे दक्षिण गंगा कहते हैं।

questions.text: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is built on which river?
questions.textHi: भाखड़ा नांगल बाँध किस नदी पर बना है?
questions.explanation: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is on the Sutlej river.
questions.explanationHi: भाखड़ा नांगल बाँध सतलुज नदी पर है।

questions.text: Which of these rivers flows westwards into the Arabian Sea?
questions.textHi: इनमें से कौन-सी नदी पश्चिम की ओर बहकर अरब सागर में गिरती है?
questions.explanation: The Narmada flows west into the Arabian Sea. Godavari, Krishna and Mahanadi flow east into the Bay of Bengal.
questions.explanationHi: नर्मदा पश्चिम की ओर अरब सागर में गिरती है; बाकी बंगाल की खाड़ी में।

questions.text: The Hirakud Dam is built on which river?
questions.textHi: हीराकुंड बाँध किस नदी पर बना है?
questions.explanation: The Hirakud Dam in Odisha is on the Mahanadi river.
questions.explanationHi: ओडिशा का हीराकुंड बाँध महानदी पर है।

questions.text: The river Ganga starts from which glacier?
questions.textHi: गंगा नदी किस हिमनद (ग्लेशियर) से निकलती है?
questions.explanation: The Ganga (as the Bhagirathi) starts from the Gangotri glacier in Uttarakhand.
questions.explanationHi: गंगा (भागीरथी) उत्तराखंड के गंगोत्री हिमनद से निकलती है।

questions.text: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.textHi: विश्व की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: The Nile in Africa is usually called the longest river in the world.
questions.explanationHi: अफ्रीका की नील नदी को सामान्यतः विश्व की सबसे लंबी नदी माना जाता है।

questions.text: The Taj Mahal city of Agra stands on the bank of which river?
questions.textHi: ताजमहल का शहर आगरा किस नदी के किनारे बसा है?
questions.explanation: Agra and the Taj Mahal are on the bank of the Yamuna.
questions.explanationHi: आगरा और ताजमहल यमुना के किनारे हैं।

questions.text: Who invented the telephone?
questions.textHi: टेलीफ़ोन का आविष्कार किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the telephone in 1876.
questions.explanationHi: टेलीफ़ोन का आविष्कार अलेक्ज़ेंडर ग्राहम बेल ने 1876 में किया।

questions.text: Who invented the practical electric light bulb?
questions.textHi: व्यावहारिक बिजली के बल्ब का आविष्कार किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Thomas Alva Edison made the first long-lasting practical electric bulb in 1879.
questions.explanationHi: थॉमस अल्वा एडिसन ने 1879 में व्यावहारिक बल्ब बनाया।

questions.text: Who discovered penicillin, the first antibiotic medicine?
questions.textHi: पहली एंटीबायोटिक दवा पेनिसिलिन की खोज किसने की?
questions.explanation: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.
questions.explanationHi: अलेक्ज़ेंडर फ़्लेमिंग ने 1928 में पेनिसिलिन की खोज की।

questions.text: Who made the first successful powered aeroplane flight in 1903?
questions.textHi: 1903 में पहली सफल इंजन-चालित हवाई जहाज़ उड़ान किसने भरी?
questions.explanation: Orville and Wilbur Wright flew the first powered aeroplane in 1903.
questions.explanationHi: ऑरविल और विल्बर राइट ने 1903 में पहली उड़ान भरी।

questions.text: Who is known for inventing the radio?
questions.textHi: रेडियो के आविष्कार के लिए कौन जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Guglielmo Marconi is known as the inventor of radio communication.
questions.explanationHi: गुग्लिएल्मो मार्कोनी को रेडियो का आविष्कारक माना जाता है।

questions.text: In 1930, C. V. Raman won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his discovery about
questions.textHi: 1930 में सी. वी. रमन को भौतिकी का नोबेल पुरस्कार किस खोज के लिए मिला?
questions.explanation: C. V. Raman discovered how light changes when it is scattered, called the Raman Effect. National Science Day (28 February) marks it.
questions.explanationHi: रमन प्रभाव प्रकाश के प्रकीर्णन से संबंधित है; 28 फ़रवरी राष्ट्रीय विज्ञान दिवस इसी की याद में है।

questions.text: Who is called the "Father of the Computer"?
questions.textHi: "कंप्यूटर का जनक" किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Charles Babbage designed the first mechanical computer, so he is called the Father of the Computer.
questions.explanationHi: चार्ल्स बैबेज ने पहला यांत्रिक कंप्यूटर बनाया।

questions.text: James Watt is famous for improving which machine?
questions.textHi: जेम्स वाट किस मशीन में सुधार के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
questions.explanation: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine. The unit of power, the watt, is named after him.
questions.explanationHi: जेम्स वाट ने भाप इंजन में सुधार किया; शक्ति की इकाई "वाट" उन्हीं के नाम पर है।

questions.text: Which is India's highest award for gallantry in war?
questions.textHi: युद्धकाल में वीरता के लिए भारत का सर्वोच्च पुरस्कार कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime gallantry award. Ashoka Chakra is the highest in peacetime.
questions.explanationHi: परमवीर चक्र युद्धकाल का सर्वोच्च वीरता पुरस्कार है।

questions.text: Where is the National Defence Academy (NDA) located?
questions.textHi: राष्ट्रीय रक्षा अकादमी (NDA) कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The NDA, where cadets of all three services train together, is at Khadakwasla near Pune.
questions.explanationHi: NDA पुणे के पास खड़कवासला में है।

questions.text: Army Day is celebrated in India every year on
questions.textHi: भारत में हर वर्ष सेना दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Army Day is on 15 January. Air Force Day is 8 October and Navy Day is 4 December.
questions.explanationHi: सेना दिवस 15 जनवरी को मनाया जाता है।

questions.text: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.textHi: भारतीय सशस्त्र सेनाओं का सर्वोच्च कमांडर कौन होता है?
questions.explanation: Under the Constitution, the President is the Supreme Commander of the Army, Navy and Air Force.
questions.explanationHi: संविधान के अनुसार राष्ट्रपति तीनों सेनाओं के सर्वोच्च कमांडर हैं।

questions.text: How many Rashtriya Military Schools are there in India?
questions.textHi: भारत में कितने राष्ट्रीय मिलिट्री स्कूल हैं?
questions.explanation: There are five: at Chail, Ajmer, Belagavi (Belgaum), Bengaluru and Dholpur.
questions.explanationHi: पाँच: चैल, अजमेर, बेलगावी, बेंगलुरु और धौलपुर।

questions.text: Indian Navy Day is celebrated on
questions.textHi: भारतीय नौसेना दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Navy Day is on 4 December. (7 December is Armed Forces Flag Day.)
questions.explanationHi: नौसेना दिवस 4 दिसंबर को है।

questions.text: What is the national animal of India?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय पशु कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The tiger (Royal Bengal tiger) is the national animal of India.
questions.explanationHi: बाघ भारत का राष्ट्रीय पशु है।

questions.text: Who wrote the national song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.textHi: राष्ट्रीय गीत "वंदे मातरम्" किसने लिखा?
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" was written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in his novel Anandmath.
questions.explanationHi: "वंदे मातरम्" बंकिम चंद्र चट्टोपाध्याय ने लिखा।

questions.text: Who wrote the national anthem "Jana Gana Mana"?
questions.textHi: राष्ट्रगान "जन गण मन" किसने लिखा?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote "Jana Gana Mana".
questions.explanationHi: "जन गण मन" रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर ने लिखा।

questions.text: On which date did the Constitution of India come into force?
questions.textHi: भारत का संविधान किस तिथि को लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation: The Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950, which we celebrate as Republic Day.
questions.explanationHi: संविधान 26 जनवरी 1950 को लागू हुआ; इसे गणतंत्र दिवस के रूप में मनाते हैं।

questions.text: What is the national flower of India?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय पुष्प कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The lotus is the national flower of India.
questions.explanationHi: कमल भारत का राष्ट्रीय पुष्प है।

questions.text: What is the capital of Assam?
questions.textHi: असम की राजधानी क्या है?
questions.explanation: Dispur, a part of Guwahati city, is the capital of Assam.
questions.explanationHi: असम की राजधानी दिसपुर है।

questions.text: Which is the highest mountain peak in India?
questions.textHi: भारत की सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: Kangchenjunga in Sikkim is the highest peak in India. (Mount Everest is in Nepal.)
questions.explanationHi: सिक्किम की कंचनजंगा भारत की सबसे ऊँची चोटी है।

questions.text: Which is the largest state of India by area?
questions.textHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे बड़ा राज्य कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state by area.
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल में राजस्थान सबसे बड़ा राज्य है।

questions.text: Which of these is a Union Territory of India?
questions.textHi: इनमें से कौन भारत का केंद्र शासित प्रदेश है?
questions.explanation: Lakshadweep is a Union Territory; Goa, Sikkim and Tripura are states.
questions.explanationHi: लक्षद्वीप केंद्र शासित प्रदेश है; बाकी राज्य हैं।

questions.text: Our skin makes which vitamin with the help of sunlight?
questions.textHi: सूर्य के प्रकाश की सहायता से हमारी त्वचा कौन-सा विटामिन बनाती है?
questions.explanation: Sunlight helps our skin make vitamin D, which keeps bones strong.
questions.explanationHi: धूप से त्वचा विटामिन D बनाती है, जो हड्डियों को मज़बूत रखता है।

questions.text: Which planet is called the "Red Planet"?
questions.textHi: किस ग्रह को "लाल ग्रह" कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red because of iron oxide (rust) in its soil.
questions.explanationHi: मंगल की मिट्टी में आयरन ऑक्साइड के कारण वह लाल दिखता है।

questions.text: Which gas do green plants take in to make their food?
questions.textHi: हरे पौधे भोजन बनाने के लिए कौन-सी गैस लेते हैं?
questions.explanation: In photosynthesis, plants use carbon dioxide, water and sunlight to make food and give out oxygen.
questions.explanationHi: प्रकाश-संश्लेषण में पौधे कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड लेकर ऑक्सीजन छोड़ते हैं।

questions.text: "Wings of Fire" is the autobiography of
questions.textHi: "विंग्स ऑफ़ फ़ायर" किसकी आत्मकथा है?
questions.explanation: "Wings of Fire" is the life story of Dr A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, the "Missile Man of India".
questions.explanationHi: "विंग्स ऑफ़ फ़ायर" डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम की आत्मकथा है।

questions.text: National Sports Day is celebrated on 29 August, the birthday of which hockey legend?
questions.textHi: राष्ट्रीय खेल दिवस 29 अगस्त को किस महान हॉकी खिलाड़ी के जन्मदिन पर मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: 29 August is the birthday of the hockey wizard Major Dhyan Chand.
questions.explanationHi: 29 अगस्त हॉकी के जादूगर मेजर ध्यानचंद का जन्मदिन है।

questions.text: In 2021, Neeraj Chopra won a gold medal for India at the Tokyo Olympics in which event?
questions.textHi: 2021 में नीरज चोपड़ा ने टोक्यो ओलंपिक में किस स्पर्धा में भारत के लिए स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
questions.explanation: In August 2021, Neeraj Chopra won gold in the javelin throw, India's first Olympic gold in athletics.
questions.explanationHi: अगस्त 2021 में नीरज चोपड़ा ने भाला फेंक में स्वर्ण जीता, एथलेटिक्स में भारत का पहला ओलंपिक स्वर्ण।

questions.text: In 2021, Mirabai Chanu won a silver medal at the Tokyo Olympics in which sport?
questions.textHi: 2021 में मीराबाई चानू ने टोक्यो ओलंपिक में किस खेल में रजत पदक जीता?
questions.explanation: Mirabai Chanu won silver in weightlifting, India's first medal at the Tokyo Olympics (held in 2021).
questions.explanationHi: मीराबाई चानू ने भारोत्तोलन में रजत जीता; यह टोक्यो ओलंपिक में भारत का पहला पदक था।

questions.text: In 2021, India's highest sports honour, the Khel Ratna Award, was renamed after
questions.textHi: 2021 में भारत के सर्वोच्च खेल सम्मान खेल रत्न पुरस्कार का नाम किसके नाम पर रखा गया?
questions.explanation: In 2021 it became the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
questions.explanationHi: 2021 में इसका नाम मेजर ध्यानचंद खेल रत्न पुरस्कार किया गया।

questions.text: In February 2021, NASA's rover that landed on Mars was named
questions.textHi: फ़रवरी 2021 में मंगल ग्रह पर उतरे नासा के रोवर का नाम क्या था?
questions.explanation: The Perseverance rover landed on Mars on 18 February 2021.
questions.explanationHi: पर्सिवियरेंस रोवर 18 फ़रवरी 2021 को मंगल पर उतरा।

questions.text: In 2021, Avani Lekhara won a gold medal at the Tokyo Paralympics in which sport?
questions.textHi: 2021 में अवनि लेखरा ने टोक्यो पैरालंपिक में किस खेल में स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
questions.explanation: Avani Lekhara won gold in 10 m air rifle shooting at the Tokyo Paralympics in 2021.
questions.explanationHi: अवनि लेखरा ने 2021 में 10 मीटर एयर राइफ़ल निशानेबाज़ी में स्वर्ण जीता।
